The hydroxide test shows a white precipitate. Now I need to distinguish between Al³⁺, Cd²⁺, Mg²⁺, and Zn²⁺. 

Key distinguishing tests:
- Al(OH)₃ and Zn(OH)₂ are amphoteric (dissolve in excess base)
- Mg(OH)₂ and Cd(OH)₂ are not amphoteric (don't dissolve in excess base)
- Cd²⁺ forms colored precipitates with sulfide (yellow CdS)
- Al³⁺, Mg²⁺, Zn²⁺ form white/colorless sulfides

Let me test if the precipitate dissolves in excess KOH (amphoteric test):
